items.title: Aug 9 spend $55.43, 6 leads, CPL $9.24
items.summary: Yesterday (Aug 9) Titan spent $55.43 CAD across 1 active campaign, generating 6 leads at a $9.24 CPL. Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign delivering spend and carried the full account total; CPL came in well under the 7-day baseline of $15.64.

needs_attention: First successful run of meta-ads-ingest-agent — no prior meta-ads.json found in the last 7 days (ingest/2026-08-03 through 2026-08-09), so this is establishing cadence rather than covering a gap. Pulled the standard yesterday window (--days 1) plus a 7-day baseline for CPL comparison.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions include lead-like types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each value=6, same as the counted max). They didn't change the lead count today, but per the script's own trap this should be reviewed and LEAD_ACTION_TYPES possibly extended rather than hand-patched here.
